# `/api/desktop/v1/` wire contract (fixtures)

These JSON files **are** the contract between the native Windows app and the Django server.
The server's tests (`backend/desktop/v1/tests/`) and the Dart tests
(`desktop-native/app/test/core/models/contract_roundtrip_test.dart`) both load them.
Normative prose: `native-rewrite/design-panel/design_data_server.md` §2 and
`architecture.md` §4.3. Where the prose and a fixture disagree, **the fixture wins** (the
deliberate differences are listed at the end).

* Generated by `desktop-native/tool/contracts/gen_v1_fixtures.py` (stdlib only):
  `python3 -I desktop-native/tool/contracts/gen_v1_fixtures.py`. Edit the generator, never
  the JSON by hand. It also rewrites `media/**` (tiny PNGs) and the Dart embed
  `app/lib/core/api/fixtures/v1_fixtures.g.dart`.
* `manifest.json` lists every fixture: `file`, `endpoint`, `method`, `path`, `kind`
  (`request` | `response` | `error`), `model` (the Dart class in
  `app/lib/core/models/`), `status`, `headers`, `note`.
* Fixture clock: `NOW = 2026-10-11T09:00:00.000Z`. Student 77 (Aziza Karimova).

## Conventions (every v1 endpoint)

| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Base | `https://mastersat.uz/api/desktop/v1/` (no trailing slash on v1 paths) |
| Request headers | `Authorization: Bearer <access>`, `X-MasterSAT-Client: windows/<semver>`, `Accept-Encoding: gzip`, `Content-Type: application/json` on writes |
| Midterm writes/reads after the handshake | `X-Lockdown-Session: <token>` (memory only, never persisted) |
| Idempotency | `Idempotency-Key: <key>` on the writes marked below. The server stores only `{outcome, status}` when status < 500 and replays the stored outcome **with a freshly built `attempt`**. 5xx is never stored |
| Envelope | Every v1 response body has `"schema": 1`. Errors: `{"code", "detail", ...}` |
| Timestamps | ISO-8601 UTC, milliseconds, `Z`: `2026-10-11T09:00:00.000Z`. Durations in ms |
| Ids in maps | JSON object keys are decimal strings: `"answers": {"301": {"1001": "B"}}` |
| Answers | `"A"`–`"D"` or the grid-in string (`^[-0-9./]*$`, ≤ 5 chars). `""` = cleared/unanswered |
| Evolution | Additive only within v1: new keys may appear (clients ignore unknown keys). Adding an **enum value** or removing/renaming a key is breaking → v2 |
| No cookies | The client never stores cookies (a cookie makes `is_native_client` false) |

### `content_hash`

`"sha256:" + hex(sha256(utf8(json.dumps(questions, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False))))`
over the module's `questions` list **exactly as served** (image keys only, never URLs).
Dart: `contentHashOf()` in `app/lib/core/models/content.dart`; the round-trip test proves both
produce the same value for every fixture module.

### AttemptLite (`"attempt"` in every read and write)

```
{id, kind:"pastpaper"|"midterm", ref_id, state, version,
 module:{id, order, duration_ms}|null, module_ids:[m1, m2],
 timing:{server_now, deadline_at|null, remaining_ms|null, paused},
 results_ready, score|null, midterm:null|{offscreen_violations, offscreen_limit,
 offscreen_grace_seconds, terminated_reason|null, desktop_required, late_grace_seconds}}
```
`state` ∈ `NOT_STARTED MODULE_1_ACTIVE MODULE_1_SUBMITTED MODULE_2_ACTIVE MODULE_2_SUBMITTED SCORING COMPLETED ABANDONED`.
`module` is the live (or next-to-start) module, null once handed in. `ref_id` is the
practice_test id or midterm id. `score` is always null for midterms. `deadline_at` is null
while paused / not started / handed in.

## Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method + path | Headers | Idempotency-Key | Fixtures |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| home | `GET home` | `If-None-Match: <etag>` → **304 empty body** when unchanged; response carries `ETag: "sha256:<hex of body>"` | — | `home.response.json`, `home.response.update_available.json` |
| pastpaper open | `POST pastpapers/{practice_test_id}/open` body `{start, have}` | — | none (naturally idempotent) | `pastpaper_open.request*.json`, `pastpaper_open.response.json` (fresh, `start:false`), `.resume` (saved answers/flags/annotations), `.cached` (`have` matched → `questions:null, unchanged:true`), `.deferred` (M2 held back) |
| pastpaper start | `POST pastpapers/attempts/{id}/start` body `{}` | — | `start.{attempt_id}` | `pastpaper_start.response.json` |
| pastpaper sync | `POST pastpapers/attempts/{id}/sync` body `{module_id, seq, answers, flagged}` | — | `sync.{attempt_id}.{module_id}.{seq}` | `pastpaper_sync.request.json`, `.response.json`, `.response.not_active.json` |
| pastpaper submit | `POST pastpapers/attempts/{id}/submit` same body | — | `submit.{attempt_id}.{module_id}` | `pastpaper_submit.request.json` (M1), `.request.final.json` (M2), `.response.json` (→ MODULE_2_ACTIVE), `.response.final.json` (→ SCORING + `result.poll_after_ms`), `.response.noop.json`, `.response.deferred.json` (`next_module`) |
| pastpaper pause | `POST pastpapers/attempts/{id}/pause` body `{}` | — | none | `pastpaper_pause.response.json` |
| pastpaper resume | `POST pastpapers/attempts/{id}/resume` body `{}` | — | none | `pastpaper_resume.response.json` |
| pastpaper result | `GET pastpapers/attempts/{id}/result?have=301:sha256:…,302:sha256:…` (split each item on the FIRST `:`) | — | — | `pastpaper_result.response.scoring.json` (200 while scoring), `.completed.json` (with review content), `.completed_cached.json` (content `questions:null`) |
| midterm prepare | `POST midterms/{midterm_id}/prepare` body `{}` or `{code}` | — | none | `midterm_prepare.request*.json`, `.response.json` (`requires_code`, not verified), `.response.verified.json`, `.response.code_incorrect.json` (403) |
| midterm challenge (existing) | `POST /api/midterms/attempts/{id}/desktop_challenge/` body `{}` | — | — | `midterm_challenge.response.json` |
| midterm session (existing) | `POST /api/midterms/attempts/{id}/desktop_session/` | — | — | `midterm_session.request.json` (`precheck` = `ms_precheck_json()` verbatim), `.response.json` |
| midterm open | `POST midterms/attempts/{id}/open` body `{have}` | `X-Lockdown-Session` | none | `midterm_open.request.json`, `.response.json` (live module only, 15-min image URLs) |
| midterm sync | `POST midterms/attempts/{id}/sync` body as pastpaper sync | `X-Lockdown-Session` | `sync.{attempt_id}.{module_id}.{seq}` | `midterm_sync.request.json`, `.response.json`, `.response.late.json` (`reason:"late"`) |
| midterm submit | `POST midterms/attempts/{id}/submit` | `X-Lockdown-Session` | `submit.{attempt_id}.{module_id}` | `midterm_submit.request.json`, `.response.json` (→ M2 with `next_module` + `media`), `.response.final.json` (→ SCORING), `.response.not_expired.json` (**409** `module_not_expired`, `retry_after_ms`, never cached) |
| midterm offscreen | `POST midterms/attempts/{id}/offscreen` body `{event_id, occurred_at, away_ms}` | `X-Lockdown-Session` | `off.{attempt_id}.{event_uuid}` | `midterm_offscreen.request.json`, `.response.json`, `.response.terminated.json` |
| midterm result | `GET midterms/attempts/{id}/result` | — | — | `midterm_result.response.scoring.json`, `.released.json`, `.awaiting_release.json` |
| media | `GET attempts/{pastpaper\|midterm}/{id}/media` | midterm: `X-Lockdown-Session` | — | `media.response.json` |
| auth login | `POST /api/desktop/auth/login/` body `{identifier, password}` (`identifier` = email, username or phone; `email` is accepted as its alias). Native clients only: 400 without `X-MasterSAT-Client`. No cookie is set | — | — | `auth_login.request.json`, `.response.json` (`{ok, access, refresh}`), `.response.invalid.json` (**401** — unknown account, wrong password, blank, deactivated: one answer), `.response.password_not_set.json` (**403** `password_not_set`: an lc-up account still on its phone + 4 digits; set the password on the website). Other 403s: `{detail}` (public learner, wrong console). 429 + `Retry-After`: per address (300/hour) and per account (10 per 15 min) |
| auth refresh (existing) | `POST /api/auth/refresh/` body `{refresh}` | — | — | `auth_refresh.request.json`, `.response.json` (rotated pair) |
| annotation write (existing) | `PUT /api/annotations/write/` | — | — | `annotation_write.request.json` → **204** (midterm `ref` = `"mt-<attempt_id>"`) |
| question report (existing) | `POST /api/question-reports/reports/` | — | `report.{uuid}` | `question_report.request.json`, `.response.json` (201), `.response.deduped.json` (200) |
| PDFs (existing) | `GET /api/classes/pastpapers/attempts/{id}/report/pdf/`, `…/certificate/pdf/`, `GET /api/midterms/attempts/{id}/error-report/pdf/`, `GET /api/classes/certificates/midterm/{code}/download/` | — | — | bytes (`application/pdf`) |

### Errors

| Status | Body | Fixture |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `{code:"practice_test_empty"\|"bad_request", detail}` | `error.400.json` |
| 401 | DRF `{detail, code:"token_not_valid", messages}` → refresh once, retry | `error.401.json` |
| 403 | `{code:"code_incorrect"\|"forbidden", detail}`; lockdown refusals keep `{detail, reason, desktop_required:true}` (no `code`) | `midterm_prepare.response.code_incorrect.json`, `error.403.lockdown.json` |
| 404 | `{code:"not_visible", detail}` | `error.404.json` |
| 409 | `{code:"state_conflict"\|"module_not_expired", detail, attempt, retry_after_ms?}` | `error.409.json`, `midterm_submit.response.not_expired.json` |
| 426 | `{detail, code:"update_required", minimum_version, latest_version, update_url}` | `error.426.json` |
| 429 | DRF `{detail}` + `Retry-After` header | `error.429.json` |
| 503 | `{code:"desktop_v1_disabled", detail}` (`DESKTOP_V1_ENABLED=False`) | `error.503.json` |

Lockdown `reason` values: `desktop_required`, `desktop_session_replaced`,
`desktop_challenge_invalid`, `desktop_proof_invalid`, `desktop_update_required`,
`desktop_not_live`.

## Deliberate differences from the design prose (fixtures win)

1. `start`, `pause`, `resume` return `{"schema":1,"attempt":{…}}` (the prose says "returns
   AttemptLite"): every response is an object with `schema`, and `attempt` is always under
   the same key.
2. AttemptLite has an extra `ref_id` (practice_test / midterm id).
3. Midterm `open` uses the **same `ExamBundle` shape** as past-paper `open`
   (`modules:[live]`, `answers:{mid:{…}}`, `flagged:{mid:[…]}`, `test`, `media`,
   `annotations`) so the client has one bundle model.
4. Module objects carry `question_count` and `deferred` on every module; submit responses
   always carry `next_module` (null or a module), `media` (list) and `result` (null or
   `{poll_after_ms}`).
5. Results carry `attempt_id` (and past-paper `practice_test_id` + `completed_at`). While
   scoring, the body is exactly `{schema, attempt_id, state, poll_after_ms}`.
6. Offscreen takes an informational body `{event_id, occurred_at, away_ms}`; the strike is
   still counted once per idempotency key.
7. Media rows are `{key, url, expires_at}`.
8. Midterm `prepare` → `rules` carries everything the rules screen shows, beyond the prose's
   `{question_count, durations_min, calculator}`: `title`, `subject`, `module_count`,
   `offscreen_limit`, `offscreen_grace_seconds`, `late_grace_seconds`, and (2026-10-11) the
   pass-mark and retake lines — `scoring_scale` (`SCALE_100`|`SCALE_800`, the sitting's own,
   pinned at start), `pass_mark` (int on that scale, **null** when the sitting is not judged
   pass/fail, i.e. a pre-midterm) and `is_retake` (bool). `calculator` is null for R&W, an
   untagged Math paper and Foundation Math (worked by hand since 2026-10-11).
